title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1568: Suppressing myriad races (2)

section.p: Immortal Realm’s entrance.
Tiangu was feeling greatly discouraged.
Was not even an ancient marquis sufficient?
Marquis Qishan had shown up. Tiangu had thought that Wisdom King had failed in the summoning, but that wasn’t the case. Marquis Qishan had instead been defeated, resulting in Wisdom King’s death.

While Tiangu was deep in thought, Su Yu roared with laughter and said, “Little bastards, keep coming at me! Don’t stop! Please show me how great and capable you are! Tiangu, why don’t you try it yourself? Kill me before I can do anything, and I’ll gladly accept my death. But upon failure, you will need to take a trip to the Death Realm with me!”
Su Yu was incomparably arrogant.

“Come on! Bring it on! Can anyone kill me? Do you think I’m He Tu? Do you think I’ll get myself killed by my own schemes? I won’t even bother with summoning death spirits out. I only need to take you all into the Death Realm with me. Who dares to face me? Tiangu? Anyone else? Pieces of trash. I’ll kill every last one of you! Are you furious? Are you angry? Come kill me!”
Nobody could say anything.
Su Yu…seemed to be really unstoppable in the Death Realm. He had blasted a marquis apart, killed Wisdom King, and killed seventeen Invincibles at one go.
“It’s already too late to kill him.”
The Devil Pseudo Emperor shook his head. Beside him, a devil king asked in confusion, “Too late?”

“Yes.” The Devil Pseudo Emperor said, “We don’t know the Death Realm well. But it is probably true that Marquis Qishan had appeared. It is also probably true that he had been defeated. Wisdom King is probably dead. And now…tell me. Would any Daofuse still have the courage to follow Su Yu into the Death Realm?”

The Devil Pseudo Emperor said, “None of them. I wouldn’t dare. Tiangu wouldn’t. Jiwu wouldn’t. Nobody! In that case, how could he be killed? If even Daofuses are afraid, who would have the courage to try? Unless someone could figure out his trump card, any further attempt today would be pointless.”

At this point, would anyone still dare to try? The only option left was an ambush by Daofuses. But with so many eyes on them, including the old turtle, was an ambush even possible? And Su Yu only needed a split second to open a death tunnel. That would be enough to guarantee his safety.

Thus, his trump card in the Death Realm must be dealt with before further attempts. But nobody knew much about his trump card in the Death Realm. Did he suffer heavy losses as well? Or perhaps an ancient human marquis was waiting down there?
They required time to dig out more information from the Death Realm. They also needed enough luck and opportunity to do so. Digging out information from the dead would be no easy task.
The Devil Pseudo Emperor’s prediction came true.
Tiangu, Heavenly Overseer Marquis, Divine Pseudo Emperor, Nether pseudo Emperor, Dragon Pseudo Emperor…
The various Daofuses were feeling very helpless.
Did they fully trust Su Yu’s claims?
Not necessarily.

But would any Daofuse still dare to pursue him all the way to the Death Realm after this? Prior to this, they would. But that had changed. What if there was really a dead human marquis down there? Not even escape would be an option when they were in the Death Realm.

However, the various races had suffered heavy losses in this operation. Su Yu had caused the deaths of eighteen Invincibles. Great Qin King had killed two. Great Zhou King had killed two. Previously, Su Yu and Wan Tiansheng had killed four. Su Yu had also killed four with Grandstar and the others.
In truth, the losses weren’t too heavy in the other battles. Only the battles involving Su Yu had incurred such losses. Thirty Invincibles had died trying to kill Su Yu.

Prior to this, thirty Invincibles had entered the Luminous Domain Mansion. The five humans had survived. The five elemental and fate had also survived. Everyone else, including the Heaven Department head, had either died or vanished. One could say that twenty-three Invincibles had been lost there.
All this had happened in the span of only one month.
Fifty-three Invincibles in one month.
After such heavy losses, Su Yu was still alive. That was not all. He had even grown massively. And now, one also needed to risk entering the Death Realm to kill him. Who? Who would be willing to go?
If nobody else dared to step forth, this conflict would end here.
It would be pointless to continue.
Tiangu inhaled deeply as his sea of willpower rumbled. A voice rang out, heard only by the ancient existences, “We stop.”
It was pointless to keep fighting.
They had to find out what was happening in the Death Realm before doing more.
Eastrift Valley.
Great Zhou King exhaled in relief.
Finally, the battle was over.
Tiangu, the person most determined to kill Su Yu, had decided to stop.

If even the immortals had decided to stop, the other races would naturally stop as well. They would only make another attempt when they were fully confident in killing Su Yu. After such heavy losses, they wouldn’t dare to make any rash attempts anymore.
Great Zhou King laughed in a self-mocking manner. Humanity had fought for hundreds of years, yet Su Yu only needed several battles to scare the myriad races off.
The myriad races had suffered massive losses in Su Yu’s hands.

One ought to admit that Su Yu was indeed blessed by luck. He had somehow obtained the backing of several Daofuses and numerous Invincibles. The power backing him was already comparable to a major race.

Naturally, his greatest backing did not come from the human race. Rather, it came from the ancient cities. Nobody had expected all these ancient guardians to leave their cities and fight for Su Yu. They were simply too strong.
“Stop?”

Su Yu had just received a voice transmission from the old turtle. It was time to stop. The eighteen deaths had sufficiently deterred the various parties from continuing the battle. Nothing would change for now unless several Daofuses were willing to step forward and follow him down to the Death Realm.

However, Su Yu merely sneered and said loudly, “Stopping now? You are very good at dreaming, Tiangu. Don’t even dream of stopping before losing ten immortal kings. Do you think I’m unaware of the situation in the Immortal Realm? Today, I will drag all those old fossils out. Let’s see just how strong these fogeys are. Are they strong enough to kill me?”
At those words, the expressions of several ancient fossils changed slightly.
Su Yu knew it! He knew everything! It occurred to them that they had greatly underestimated him. He knew everything clearly!

With a sneer, Su Yu continued, “Just send them out. I refuse to believe that I can’t make those old bastards pay as well. Show me. Show me what it takes to kill me. Let’s break the balance. Let’s see if that’s all it takes to end this epoch. Everyone is trying to take advantage of my youth and ignorance. Do you think I know nothing?”

At that, several gazes focused on the old turtle. But the old turtle remained indifferent. Why were they looking at him? He had told Su Yu nothing. There were things he could and couldn’t say. He had no idea how Su Yu had learned about all that.

In truth, Su Yu did not know as much as they thought. He had merely made use of the little bit of information he received from Heavendoom and pretended he knew more. Yes. He was merely pretending to know more. He wanted to give the myriad races the impression that he knew everything. And he was confident he could deal with whatever they had to offer. That was all.

Not even Tiangu dared to keep viewing him as an ignorant junior anymore. Tiangu’s voice rang out, “Su Yu, are you sure you want to start the final battle now? Do you think you’re better than the Hundred Battle King? If you’re confident, I’ll oblige.”

Su Yu’s heart thumped. No, wait! He was simply talking shit! Why was the old bastard taking him seriously? If an old fossil capable of killing human kings were to appear, he would die. But he had to keep acting. He couldn’t stop halfway.

Thus, he coldly said, “Sure. Bring it on, Tiangu. Why don’t you kill a few immortal kings personally and drag those geezers out to have some fun with me? Let’s see if they’re good enough to kill me. Do you think I’m really so helpless against them?”
Su Yu gnashed his teeth and roared furiously at the floating White Jade Gate, “Tai Shan!”
He did not know if anything would come out of this. He was merely trying his luck. If something were to happen, that would be enough to scare these people further. If nothing happened, so be it.
Immediately after…
A deafening rumble rang out. Space itself started shaking. An incomparably powerful aura surged out of the gate, but something seemed to be stopping it from spreading.

Su Yu was greatly shaken as well, but he kept a look of wild joy on his face. He flew over and stopped near the White Jade Gate. There, he sneered and said, “Tiangu, stop being a coward. Tell those geezers to come out. Lord Heavendoom, respected guardians, kill more immortal kings. Don’t stop before killing ten of them. Today, we shatter the sky above us!”
Behind him, the White Jade Gate shook even more violently, as though it was responding to his words.
The expressions of some Daofuses started changing.
Was Su Yu capable of controlling that terrifying existence in the mansion even from the outside?
Many recalled what they had heard from the survivors previously.
The Daofuses started sending voice transmissions to the survivors. “Auspicious Golden, tell me the truth. Just how strong was that ancient existence?”
“Null Seer, did you encounter that ancient existence inside?”
The various experts were doing the same. This was too scary. They had to be very careful here.

Null Seer and Auspicious Golden spoke the truth. “I don’t know about the actual strength of that existence. I only know that a clump of willpower appeared out of nowhere. After that, all the active Eternals were either killed or crippled. Not even Blood Fire Devil King could escape unscathed. He was weakened so much that even Su Yu could kill him.”

“His exact strength is hard to judge for me, but after his appearance, Great Qin King was able to take the Source Return Blade away. That existence must have crushed even the laws there, freeing the blade from the laws.”
The hearts of the various experts thumped nervously.
Source Return Blade.

They had nearly forgotten that Great Qin King was fighting with a saber earlier. In that case, someone must have shattered the laws, freeing Devote King’s weapon. And someone capable of a feat like that would be no weaker than a human king. An ancient human king.
In short, there was another backer behind Su Yu, one as strong as an ancient human king.

Meanwhile, Su Yu’s heart was thumping violently. He was still maintaining his act. This act was necessary to deter the myriad races from trying anything against him anytime soon. He had to make them think twice before trying anything in the future, even with full preparations. Otherwise, more troubles would follow after this conflict.

Stopping the conflict here? That was what Su Yu wanted as well. He didn’t want to risk attracting those old fossils. After all, the attention of the old fossils was something that had killed even the human king of the previous epoch. He most certainly didn’t want to face something like that at his current stage. Thus, he couldn’t show any fear.
Agreeing to the ceasefire would only reveal weakness and bring him more trouble.
Su Yu looked around with a sneer and coldly said, “Come. Let’s have some fun. Let’s see if the dead or the living are better.”
“Su Yu, you might be able to summon that existence, but you would definitely need to pay a large price for it. Am I right?”
Tiangu questioned coldly.

“Price?” Su Yu laughed and said, “Do you want to see it for yourself? I don’t mind being honest. This Lord of mine…is without some of his memories. He loves killing indiscriminately. I might be the first to die after summoning him, but you’re forcing me to do this. If I’m dying either way, I might as well drag everyone with me. Human king? Do you think he’s a mere human king? No, not at all. He’s stronger than that. Do you think I’m bluffing? Tiangu, are you ready to…embrace madness together?”
Tiangu did not answer.
Su Yu extended his willpower toward the White Jade Gate while trembling inwardly and roared again, “Tai Shan!”
This time, the massive rumble seemed to reverberate throughout the Myriad Realms.
It was likely that Old Zhou was already boundlessly furious.
Su Yu couldn’t hear Old Zhou’s voice anymore, but he knew that Old Zhou was definitely furious.
Boom!
The entire Sea of Stars started shaking. Up in the sky, lightning bolts started flickering as a tribulation started forming.
The expressions of Tiangu and the others changed drastically.

The intense shaking continued as a bolt of lightning shot toward the White Jade Gate. Su Yu hurriedly moved away in panic when he saw the incoming lightning. The bolt of lightning continued heading toward the gate. It was so powerful that it left a path of nothingness behind it as it descended.
“Fuck off!”
Just then, a boundlessly furious voice resounded in everyone’s ears.
Su Yu started coughing blood. He was not alone.
The old turtle, the Heavenly Overseer Marquis…
The stronger one was, the more intense their reaction.
All the Daofuses coughed blood.
The Invincibles were coughing blood as well. Meanwhile, almost everyone under the Invincible Realm was unaffected. They heard nothing.
Then, the incomparably powerful bolt of lightning was shattered by an incorporeal power.
The sky itself was torn apart.
The power of laws started gathering again, forming yet another blood lightning to strike the gate.
Su Yu was completely stunned. What was this? He had only provoked Old Zhou. Nothing else. What was this reaction?
